revisions.name: $handle_CreateWindowExA
revisions.reason: Review 20261126 Unicode native-control text: the two synchronous WAT-native WM_CREATE dispatches (system-class top level, native child control) now pass an ANSI copy of CREATESTRUCTW from $createstruct_narrow_for_native when the call came through CreateWindowExW, and free it after the synchronous $wat_wndproc_dispatch returns. No guest callback, EIP write or frame change is added; the guest-visible CREATESTRUCTW at wnd_scratch is unchanged.
